description: The labelled feedback set (constitution II): a prompt, skill or analysis change must keep every confirmed label among the accepted items of its case and every dismissed label out of them. Labels name items by host and metric; verdicts mirror the Slack reactions they stand for.

labels.note: A seven-hour monotonic climb to three times yesterday is exactly what the on-call engineer wants flagged.
Conflicts on beta sit within normal noise that day; flagging them would be a false positive.
